parts.name: Root
parts.description: The group container. It makes a div with role="group". It holds the checked state of the boxes in it.

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected values. When you give this prop, it is the source of truth, with `bind:value` or
without it. The component writes each change here and reports it through `onChange`.

Without a binding, that write stays local. Thus a parent that hears `onChange` and refuses the
change — it sends no new `value` down — sees the group move. The group then goes back to the
value of the parent at the next render.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected values at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the selection.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` of the hidden input of every checkbox in the group, for form submission.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables each checkbox in the group.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows the value of the group, and refuses each change from the user.

props.name: required
props.description:
Records that the group needs an answer. It gives `data-required` for your styles, and it
does not enforce a minimum count. It marks neither the group nor the boxes with
`aria-required`: `role="group"` does not support that property, and native `required` on a
box demands that one box. Say it in the group label, and give the reason with
`aria-describedby`.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation of the layout. It sets `data-orientation` for your styles. It does not change
the keyboard behavior: each checkbox keeps its own tab stop.

props.name: children
props.description: The checkboxes of the group.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the group element. The component makes one when you give none.

props.name: element
props.description: The group element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

props.name: context
props.description:
The state of the group. Use `bind:context` to read `allSelected` and `someSelected` for a
parent "select all" checkbox, and to call `selectAll` and `clearAll`.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-group-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The group orientation ("horizontal" or "vertical").

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is read only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is required.

dataAttributes.description: Present when the box is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the box is not checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present when the box is in the mixed state.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the box is held down.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
